table.title: [Pilotage Charges, Tientsin Harbour]
table.caption_extra: Tientsin Harbour. "Pilotage : Not compulsory. The pilotage charges are as follows :—"

rows: From outside bar to Pilot Town :— Sailing vessels, Tls. 5 per foot; Steamers or sailing vessels in tow, Tls. 4 per foot; To any point above Pilot Town up to Hsinho wharves the charge shall be 1 tael more per foot.
From Pilot Town, Taku, Tangku and Hsinho wharves to Tientsin :— Sailing vessels, Tls. 6 per foot; Steamers or sailing vessels in tow, Tls. 4 per foot
For vessels of over 1,200 tons net register a tonnage charge of 3 tael cents for every ton over 1,200 tons shall be leviable in cases (a) and (b).
6 feet shall be considered the minimum draught, e.g., a vessel drawing 5 feet shall pay for 6 feet.
Fractions of a half foot shall pay for the full half foot.

Shifting vessels in the port, (i.e. Outer Anchorage, Taku, Tangku and Tientsin), including shifting a vessel from any point between the mouth of the river and the Tangku wharves up to the wharves at Hsinho, 25 taels together with 1 tael cent for every ton over 1,200 tons net register.

Boarding a vessel within the 5-mile limit outside the bar and anchoring her in the outer anchorage, 2 taels per foot draught, excluding such vessels as have to anchor to wait for high water to cross the bar.
For detention at Tientsin over 36 hours the pilot shall be entitled to 25 taels per day of 24 hours.

A pilot carried off the station by any vessel, through stress of weather, blockage of ice or from other causes not his own fault, shall be entitled to an allowance of 10 taels per day until he can reach Tientsin, besides his return passage.
